title: Deductible Breadth Test for Replacement Cancellations — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
**Breadth test — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) requests signed under Replaced by Private Flood for a Tidemark HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies replacement**

The breadth test compares the replacing policy's deductible with this policy's own deductible, which is the contents deductible on a policy with no building coverage and the building deductible otherwise. The replacing deductible may exceed it by:

| This NFIP Dwelling Form policy | Replacing HomeFlood plan | Allowed excess |
|---|---|---|
| Not mortgage-required | HomeFlood Renters | 1000 dollars |
| Not mortgage-required | Any other plan | 500 dollars |
| Mortgage-required | Any plan | Nothing (0 dollars) |

When the replacing deductible exceeds this policy's deductible by more than that, the request may be dated no earlier than the signing date.

*Hypothetical cases.* A non-mortgage-required building policy with a 2,000-dollar building deductible replaced by a HomeFlood plan other than Renters with a 2,500-dollar deductible passes (excess 500); with a 3,000-dollar deductible it fails. On a mortgage-required policy any higher replacing deductible fails, and an equal one passes.
